genxml.title: QLogic ISP1040 family SCSI host adapter (PCI 1077:1020), register and mailbox contract
genxml.doc: The single-channel QLogic SCSI host adapter on the BaseIO and BaseIO-G boards (PCI 1077:1020), as the public drivers use it. Grades say how each item was derived: established means the public driver file or the published standard states it, and inferred means agreeing driver code, a driver's own default, or a reading of the drivers' use of a value. No QLogic programming manual for this part is held here, so the register contract rests on driver agreement, and the reset state of every register is unknown unless a row says otherwise. The bus-reset and selection timing values are the driver's requests, not measured chip behaviour.

struct.name: ID_L
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout
struct.doc: Low half of the identity word. The reset value is not stated by any source.

struct.name: ID_H
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout
struct.doc: High half of the identity word. The reset value is not stated by any source.

struct.name: CFG_0
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout; qla1280 driver hardware revision test
struct.doc: Configuration 0. Its low four bits hold the hardware revision. Linux compares that revision with the 1040A value only, to decide whether to set the FIFO threshold. Linux does not use it to name the part.

struct.name: CFG_1
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout
struct.doc: Configuration 1: FIFO threshold and bus burst enable, written by the drivers at start-up.

struct.name: ICTRL
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout and its use in qla1280 driver
struct.doc: Bus interface control. It holds the soft reset bit, the interrupt enables and the flash BIOS controls.

struct.name: ISTATUS
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout
struct.doc: Interface status. Its bit meanings are not described here; the reset value is unknown.

struct.name: SEMAPHORE
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout
struct.doc: Semaphore register. Linux names it; its use is not described here.

struct.name: NVRAM
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout
struct.doc: Serial NVRAM interface register. Linux names its clock, select, data-out and data-in bits.

struct.name: FLASH_DATA
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header and OpenBSD qlw driver header, both naming the flash data word
struct.doc: Flash BIOS data. Linux and OpenBSD both name it for this part. The NetBSD driver assigns the same offset to request-queue pointers for a later chip generation, so the naming rests on two drivers and is not confirmed by a manual.

struct.name: FLASH_ADDRESS
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header and OpenBSD qlw driver header, both naming the flash address word
struct.doc: Flash BIOS address. The same naming and the same two-driver footing as the flash data word.

struct.name: MAILBOX
struct.from: Linux qla1280 driver header device register layout (mailbox 0 at 0x70); OpenBSD QLW_MBOX_BASE_PCI
struct.doc: Eight 16-bit mailbox registers, mailboxes 0 to 7 at 0x70 to 0x7e. Mailbox 0 carries the opcode of each command. The other mailboxes carry its operands and results, and their meaning is given per opcode below.
